Preserve the entire portrait framing and exact visible state: same playfield geometry, positions, counts, character/item identities, functional colors, recognizable poses, functional footprints, HUD footprints, tutorial cue, wording and numeric values. Retain +3 Knights left, +5 Geese right, Player54399 versus WIZARD, three hearts each, 1/3 and the original arena/card footprints.

one uniform opaque solid color per shape, zero gradients anywhere; all buttons/counters/hand also completely unlit flat with outlines rather than shadow; do not add decorative labels
